layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode B for Dashboards) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout.alignment: Left-aligned for dense content; asymmetrical layouts for marketing pages.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use pure geometric CSS patterns (like abstract hex grids) or high-contrast solid color blocking. Avoid soft gradients.

components.button: bg-primary text-primary-foreground border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] transition-all
components.card: bg-white border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] p-6 lg:p-8 rounded-none
components.input: bg-white border-2 border-black p-3 font-mono focus:ring-0 focus:border-secondary focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,85,255,1)] transition-all outline-none
components.navigation: bg-white border-b-2 border-black sticky top-0 z-50 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center
components.dialog: bg-white border-4 border-black shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] p-8 rounded-none

image_urls.description: Abstract honeycomb/hexagonal background for the landing page hero section. Extreme angle, pure white, black, and amber. Use as an underlying visual behind bold text.
Productivity workspace flat lay, useful for 'How it Works' or 'Get Organized' sections on the landing page.
Hackathon team working together. Use for About Us or Community sections.
Group of people around a table with laptops. Use for 'Collaborative Scheduling' feature illustration.

instructions_to_main_agent.component_strategy: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing pages (to achieve asymmetric, overlapping, neo-brutalist layouts). Use heavily customized Shadcn components for Dashboard, Forms, and complex logic (e.g., Dialogs, Calendars).
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Strip default Vercel-like styling from Shadcn components. Remove soft shadows and rounded corners. Replace with border-2 border-black and hard shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)].
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with 'bold' or 'duotone' weight to match the thick borders of the neo-brutalist style.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='create-meeting-submit-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.contrast_rules: Ensure all text overlaid on the primary yellow or secondary blue has strict black or white contrast to meet WCAG AA.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_type_note: Apply these guidelines to .js/.jsx files as there are no .tsx files.
instructions_to_main_agent.animation: Interactions should feel stark and raw. Use hard state swaps or fast linear transitions instead of slow, easing fades.
